name: TradePad
summary: TradePad is a graphical trade panel utility EA that provides a visual interface (CTradePanel) for manual trading operations on the MetaTrader 5 chart. It does not generate its own trading signals but instead delegates all user interactions from chart events, ticks, and timers to the CTradePanel object for order management and display.
summary_zh: TradePad是一个图形化交易面板工具EA，在MetaTrader 5图表上提供可视化界面（CTradePanel）用于手动交易操作。它不自主产生交易信号，而是将图表事件、Tick和定时器的用户交互委托给CTradePanel对象进行订单管理和信息展示。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非策略型交易程序，而是一个交易面板工具类EA。它通过创建CTradePanel窗体对象为用户提供图形化交互界面，用户可以在面板上手动执行交易操作如开仓、平仓、修改订单等。入场和出场条件完全由用户通过面板手动决定，EA本身不包含任何自动化策略逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理同样依赖于用户的手动输入和判断，EA仅提供操作界面和行情信息展示（通过CSymbolInfo获取品种信息）。程序在初始化时会等待图表可见K线加载完成，最多重试10次，确保面板在图表就绪后才创建。定时器每秒触发一次，用于更新面板上的行情数据和状态信息。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a strategy-based trading program but rather a trade panel utility EA. It creates a CTradePanel form object to provide users with a graphical interactive interface for manually executing trading operations such as opening/closing positions and modifying orders. Entry and exit conditions are entirely determined by the user through the panel manually; the EA itself does not contain any automated strategy logic. Position sizing and money management also rely entirely on the user's manual input and judgment, with the EA only providing the operational interface and market information display (obtained via CSymbolInfo for symbol info). During initialization, the program waits for visible chart bars to load, retrying up to 10 times with 1-second intervals, ensuring the panel is created only after the chart is ready. The timer fires every second to update market data and status information displayed on the panel.

parameters.name: g_limit_attempts
parameters.description: 初始化时等待图表就绪的最大重试次数
parameters.description_en: Max retries to wait for chart readiness on init

parameters.name: Timer interval
parameters.description: 定时器间隔秒数，用于面板数据刷新
parameters.description_en: Timer interval in seconds for panel data refresh

pros: 提供图形化交易界面，便于用户快速手动操作交易
初始化逻辑健壮，有重试机制确保图表就绪后才创建面板
事件委托设计清晰，将所有事件统一转发给CTradePanel处理，主程序结构简洁
pros_en: Provides a graphical trading interface for quick manual trading operations
Robust initialization logic with retry mechanism ensuring panel creation only after chart is ready
Clean event delegation design forwarding all events to CTradePanel, keeping the main program structure concise
cons: 无自动交易策略，完全依赖用户手动操作，缺乏自动化能力
错误处理不完善，创建失败时仅打印信息但未做资源清理回退
缺少输入参数暴露，硬编码的重试次数和定时器间隔无法由用户自定义
cons_en: No automated trading strategy; fully reliant on manual user operations, lacking automation capability
Incomplete error handling; only prints messages on creation failure without resource cleanup or rollback
Missing input parameter exposure; hardcoded retry count and timer interval cannot be customized by users
improvements: 将硬编码参数（重试次数、定时器间隔）改为input变量，允许用户自定义配置
增强错误处理逻辑，在初始化失败时正确清理已分配的资源，避免内存泄漏
improvements_en: Convert hardcoded parameters (retry count, timer interval) to input variables for user customization
Enhance error handling logic to properly clean up allocated resources on initialization failure, avoiding memory leaks

risk_points: 作为工具类EA，不自主开仓，交易风险由用户完全掌控
初始化失败时可能存在部分资源未释放的轻微内存泄漏风险
risk_points_en: As a utility EA, it does not open positions autonomously; trading risk is fully controlled by the user
Minor memory leak risk if initialization fails partway through with some resources not released

It does not generate its own trading signals but instead delegates all user interactions from chart events, ticks, and timers to the CTradePanel object for order management and display.
